stories.title: Indian court orders release of two leaders of Cockroach movement

It was “now clear” that the study “will not move forward in Guinea-Bissau”, Frederik Schaltz-Buchholzer, a Danish researcher, wrote on LinkedIn, adding, “we were not given the necessary governmental approval.” Continue reading...

EU officials argue that the UK, Canada and Japan should do more to support Ukraine, but entreaties to these G7 countries for extra financial aid at recent international meetings have not been answered, Brussels says. Mumbai-based Jio Platforms, a telecoms company backed by Meta Platforms and Google, is hoping to raise up to 302bn rupees (£2.4bn) and is targeting a 10.3tn rupees valuation when it floats on the stock market from Wednesday.

stories.title: Aung San Suu Kyi’s son speaks to detained former Myanmar leader for first time in five years

Hearing her voice again means more than words can express,” Kim Aris said in a post on Facebook on Thursday. Continue reading...
